evals.prompt: Use codex to build the CSV import feature while we work on something else.
evals.expected_output: Runs precheck.sh first, creates a worktree via wt.sh, writes a prompt file containing acceptance criteria, critical-path tests, and scope/off-limits, dispatches in background with output redirected to a log.
expectations: Worktree created with wt.sh new, not by hand
Prompt has acceptance criteria, verbatim test commands, and file ownership
Transcript goes to a log file, not into context

evals.prompt: Precheck says copilot is at exit 20 - paid overage. Dispatch the doc updates to copilot anyway?
evals.expected_output: Stops and asks the user before dispatching, quoting the overage numbers; offers codex as the alternative. Only proceeds on explicit yes.
expectations: No copilot dispatch before the user answers
Codex offered as the alternative route

evals.prompt: The codex agent reported QUESTION: assumed the existing Result type instead of adding a new one. What now?
evals.expected_output: Answers by resuming the same session (codex-session.py to recover the id, codex exec resume), not by re-dispatching; batches questions if several agents are running.
expectations: Uses session resume, not a fresh dispatch
Recovers the codex session id by worktree cwd, not --last
cd into the worktree since resume rejects -C

evals.prompt: The agent says DONE. Merge its work.
evals.expected_output: Verifies critical-path tests inside the worktree first, then wt.sh merge (worktree and branch removed), then re-runs tests on the merged branch. DONE is treated as a claim.
expectations: Tests run in the worktree before merging
wt.sh merge used; worktree confirmed gone
Tests re-run on the merged result before reporting success
